summary.markdown:
### 🚀 Features & Enhancements
- **Per-project Install Flow** (Track 003): New projects need conductor/ structure, Makefile targets, and skill symlink.
- **Init** (Track 004): Confirm the full setup flow works on a real project.
- **DB as Transport for Conductor File Content** (Track 005): No columns exist to store conductor file content or track markdown content.
- **Interactive Track Workflow** (Track 006): The Kanban board is read-only. There is no way to move cards between lanes, no way to record a conversation/blockers on a track, and no automated back-to-backlog flow when implementation hits something unexpected.
- **Review Skill** (Track 007): No review command exists in SKILL.md.
- **New Track UI Flow** (Track 008): No server endpoint to create tracks from the UI.
- **Verify File Sync + Heartbeat** (Track 009): No way to confirm the heartbeat worker is alive without manual inspection.
- **Auto-Implement on Start** (Track 010): Worker has no awareness of fresh in-progress transitions.
- **Heartbeat & Sync Hardening** (Track 011): chokidar fires on every write; VS Code saves 2-3x per save; conductor files always UPDATE Postgres even when unchanged.
- **the laneconductor setting if the collector should also create default quiality gate.md** (Track 012): The database and API do not recognize the `quality-gate` status or the new project setting.
- **Planning Lane + Smart New-Track Flow** (Track 013): Three related issues with the current new-track flow:
- **Worker Registration and UI** (Track 014): No storage or retrieval mechanism for worker status.
- **Track Conversation Inbox** (Track 015): Track list endpoints have no way to surface per-track conversation state (how many AI messages the user hasn't responded to). No dedicated endpoint exists for aggregating inbox-style data.
- **Landing Page** (Track 016): No public web presence for LaneConductor.
- **Cloud Mode** (Track 017): LaneConductor is local-only. Developers want remote visibility and team collaboration without
- **git_global_id Schema + Population** (Track 018): `projects` table has no cross-machine project identity column.
- **Canary** (Track 999): Need a simple task to verify the workflow.
- **GitHub OAuth + Collector Auth + Supabase Sync** (Track 1002): No identity layer exists — the Express server (port 8091) accepts all requests anonymously.
- **LaneConductor App Billing** (Track 1003): Initial planning phase - defining billing requirements and data model
- **Smart LLM Provider Exhaustion Handling** (Track 1004): No way to track LLM provider health.
- **Multi-User Data Model & Auth Architecture** (Track 1005): LaneConductor has no ownership or identity model. Three gaps:
- **Workflow Logic (Retry & Transitions)** (Track 1006): Track transitions and retries are hardcoded, making the workflow rigid. Multi-tenant environments require local repo configuration (`workflow.md`) to be the authority for execution flow.
- **lets deploy app.laneconductor.com** (Track 1007): We need the Firebase project configuration to support a new site and functions.
- **per lane llm** (Track 1008): Identify where to inject the override logic in the heartbeat worker.
- **Schema and DB Migration Management** (Track 1009): All phases complete. Prisma and Atlas are fully integrated and documented.
- **Worker Coordination Architecture** (Track 1010): Unified coordination for multi-worker, multi-pattern execution with bidirectional file-DB sync and isolated worktrees
- **Multi-CLI Agent Support (Gemini, Codex, Amp)** (Track 1013): Complete multi-CLI wiring for Codex and Amp; fix hardcoded skill path; add exhaustion detection for all CLIs
- **Dev Server Quick-Start from Kanban Card** (Track 1014): No columns to store dev server config or running PID per project.
- **Centralized MCP Configuration (Extension-Only)** (Track 1015): Provide specialized, project-specific MCP servers (e.g., knowledge base, browser) that are not natively supported by LLM CLIs.
- **Lane Status Enum Implementation** (Track 1016): Database uses String type for lane_action_status; no type safety.
- **Three Operating Modes — Docs, Tests and Worker Polish** (Track 1017): LaneConductor now supports three operating modes but they are undocumented, undertested, and the local-fs mode has noise from git lock/worktree operations that assume a real git remote.
- **Universal CLI Commands** (Track 1019): Finalizing CLI for NPM distribution and cleaning up codebase.
- **Workflow Standardization & Enhanced Transitions** (Track 1020): Standardized architecture to "One Name" model (Lane === Action) and implemented flexible `lane:status` transitions.
- **lc config in ui** (Track 1024): UI panel + API endpoints to read/write project config (CLI, model, dev server, quality gate) from Kanban board
- **Clean up Makefile** (Track 1025): Remove project commands from Makefile that were moved to lc.mjs and patch lc status error fallback
- **File Sync Queue — Filesystem Message Bus** (Track 1027): Rename intake.md to file_sync_queue.md and implement it as the filesystem-side message bus, symmetric counterpart to the DB file_sync_queue table
- **Track 1028: E2E Test 1772624828336** (Track 1028): ## Problem
- **Machine Workers View in All Projects Mode** (Track 1029): Enable a global view of all machine workers across all registered projects when in "All Projects" mode, ensuring consistent visibility of the worker fleet regardless of the currently selected project.
- **feature** (Track 1032): Implemented premium landing page and dashboard updates. Cleaned remote database, applied Atlas migrations, and deployed to Firebase. Verified correct content on `laneconductor-site.web.app`.
- **Worker Use Connection** (Track 1033): Implemented API key authentication, worker visibility (private/team/public), and strict path isolation for secure worker coordination. Verified remote registration and sharing permissions. All 15/15…
- **Track 1034: windows parity** (Track 1034): ## Problem
- **Persistent Worktree Lifecycle** (Track 1035): Implementation complete (per-cycle worktree reuse, merge on done:success). Awaiting Phase 4: E2E test, product.md docs, tech-stack.md config docs.
- **Worktree Lock Manager** (Track 1036): Implement visibility and control over git worktree locks. Currently when a worker locks a track's worktree, there is no way to see which tracks are locked, release a lock, or merge partial progress…
- **lc start in sync mode only** (Track 1042): lets have two options for the worker to run inwhen its in api (local/remote) mode, one is like today its syncs and also takes things from the queue - the other is sync only meaning user will trigger…
- **Test-Driven Track Files** (Track 1043): Add test.md as a fourth track file — closes the TDD loop across plan/implement/review/quality-gate phases, synced by worker, rendered in UI.
- **Cloud /api/keys endpoints missing** (Track 1046): Three endpoints missing from cloud function — UI gets 404.
- **Super LaneConductor** (Track 1047): implement can read tests.md but doesn't enforce test-first order.
- **GitHub Repo Polish** (Track 1048): README has no visual. hero.png exists at ui/public/hero.png but needs to be at a stable, publicly accessible path in the repo.
- **Demo GIF / Screen Recording** (Track 1049): GIF recorded, committed to docs/demo.gif, embedded in README.
- **Gemini CLI Discussion Repost** (Track 1050): Need a post that converts — story hook, demo GIF, Gemini angle, clean install block.
- **Anthropic / Claude Code Community Post** (Track 1051): Need a Claude-audience version of the Gemini post — same story, different angle.
- **Show HN Post** (Track 1052): Post v2 live at https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48046969 — measuring score after 48h window.
- **Reddit Launch Posts** (Track 1053): All direct posts removed (karma). Submitted to r/ClaudeAI Built with Claude Showcase Megathread — live. r/LocalLLaMA and r/SideProject deferred until karma established.
- **Twitter/X Thread** (Track 1054): Twitter thread targeting the developer + AI tools community
- **Dev.to / Hashnode Blog Post** (Track 1055): Technical blog post driving long-tail organic traffic and credibility
- **Product Hunt Listing** (Track 1056): Cancelled — not aligned with open source adoption goal. Product Hunt is a launch spike for consumer products; focus shifted to developer communities, README/demo quality, and curated lists.
- **Track 1061: CLI gaps with worker** (Track 1061): QG failed: 9 UI auth tests failing (/auth/me returns 200 without token) — unrelated to track 1061 changes
- **Deployment Context & lc deploy Command** (Track 1062): Add deployment as a first-class citizen in LaneConductor: lc setup-deploy (guided setup with templates), deployment-stack.md context file, lc deploy command, and zero-secrets-in-repo policy using…
- **setup simplification** (Track 1063): All core "One-Flow" features verified. Ready for Quality Gate checks (linting, tests, security scan) before final closure.**Last Run**: claude/haiku (primary)
- **Track 1064: add copilot cli support** (Track 1064): ## Problem
- **lc deploy — AI Error Recovery** (Track 1065): When lc deploy fails, enter an interactive AI brainstorm loop to diagnose and fix the error, then re-run the failed step as a verification gate before continuing
- **Jira Integration — Polling-Based Bidirectional Sync** (Track 1067): ✅ COMPLETE. Worker polls Jira every 60 seconds with bidirectional sync. Latest-version-wins conflict resolution implemented. API dependency removed (local-fs mode). Jira status validation +…
- **Marketing & Sales (Biz Dev) Track Support** (Track 1068): Extend LaneConductor to support non-dev track types (marketing, sales, support) with KPI definitions, auto-research measurement, closed-loop experiment workflow, and skill recommendations.
- **LinkedIn Launch Post** (Track 1069): Personal LinkedIn post for LaneConductor launch — founder story angle, Karpathy autoresearch hook, whole-business AI orchestration scope
- **DEV.to Article** (Track 1070): Technical DEV.to article — context loss between Claude and Gemini, solved with Kanban structure. Shows actual file contents, two-layer context model, multi-agent handoff.
- **CLI Help — Scoped Sections** (Track 1071): Rewrote `lc --help` into scoped sections; removed `lc install` (no-op after make install) from CLI, landing page, wiki, and SKILL.md; clarified ui/worker scope in post-setup hints.
- **Landing Page — Updated 3-Step Setup Flow** (Track 1072): Update laneconductor.com with the corrected 3-step setup flow and create a dedicated /welcome page for new users.
- **Support Antigravity Extension** (Track 1073): Add support for Google Antigravity custom workspace skill and rules to make LaneConductor work as an Antigravity extension. Update the setup command in `bin/lc.mjs` and the setup documentation in…
- **Structured Pino logging for the worker + UI/API, with a live Pinorama viewer** (Track 1075): Standalone `pinorama --server` on port 6201 + `pinorama-transport` wired into both the worker and API's Pino loggers, tagged by `component`. New `lc logs [start|stop|status|open]` command, auto-launched from `worker start`/`restart`/`api start`. **Phase 6**: the new logging surfaced 4 real crashes already in `ui/.api.log` — all from unhandled `'error'` events (pg pool idle-client drops, `server.listen()` EADDRINUSE, and `ws`'s `WebSocketServer` re-emitting the http server's `'error'` onto itself). Fixed all three sources; verified live by reproducing both crash scenarios against the running dev API and confirming it now survives and logs cleanly instead of crashing.
- **Migrate Gemini CLI support to Antigravity** (Track 1077): CLI-dispatch already fully supported `agy`/antigravity alongside `gemini` before this track (`runAIAgent`/`callLLMConversational` in `bin/lc.mjs`, `buildCliArgs` in `laneconductor.sync.mjs` —…
- **Add conductor/design-language.md to project scaffolding** (Track 1078): Added `conductor/design-language.md` to scaffold generation (file list, progress-print, Mode A inference, "Both modes create" tree, plus a template covering color tokens, typography scale, spacing,…
- **Run the Collector API as a systemd --user service** (Track 1079): The Collector API was dying silently roughly every hour because it lived inside the launching terminal's `vte-spawn-*.scope` cgroup — `detached`/`setsid`/`unref()` escape the shell's process group…
- **MCP server for the Collector API** (Track 1080): Thin MCP (stdio) server wrapping the existing `localhost:8091` REST API (list/get/move/comment/create tracks + inbox), for MCP clients without repo/filesystem access (Claude Desktop, etc.).…
- **Lane View — Focused Single-Lane Board** (Track 1082): Lanes with more than 5 tracks are truncated to 5 with a "+N more →" link into a Lane View (tabs + status filter + full card grid). A shared toolbar adds sort (Track #/Date, asc/desc) and text search…
- **Showcase Migrated Lab Projects on LaneConductor Landing Page** (Track 1083): Add a section to laneconductor.com's landing page showcasing the projects being migrated off ocumentor.com (5Elements, Chess AI Mentor, The Hero's Journey, Otralingo, and Sage Council if it gets a hom
- **Worker Identity & Assignment** (Track 1084): Explicit track assignment to end random pickup; worker ownership resolved via workers.user_uid, not a separate pin table.
- **Manual Worker Dispatch** (Track 1085): Per-worker dispatch inbox to manually trigger a lane action or a deploy in sync-only mode.
- **Persistent Track Sessions** (Track 1086): One resumable Claude session per (worker, track) across the whole lifecycle.
- **Live Session Transcript Panel** (Track 1087): Collapsible right-side panel rendering a track's session live, replacing the raw log tail.
- **Remote Worker Provisioning** (Track 1089): Activate a worker on an already-known remote machine from the app, delegated through an existing worker — SSH execution itself deferred (FFU).
- **Remote Browser Visibility** (Track 1090): Options for letting the app show a browser a remote worker is driving (e.g. during E2E tests) — not yet decided which, if any, to build.
- **Manager Worker Type & New-Project Flow** (Track 1091): A distinct 'manager' worker type that can act system-wide (create new projects) instead of being scoped to one project like every worker today.
- **Deploy Configuration UI** (Track 1092): Web UI to view/edit conductor/deploy.json's environments, so deploy config isn't CLI-or-hand-edit-only.
- **Conversation Tab Auto-Scroll Steals User Control** (Track 1094): Scrolling up in a track's Conversation tab keeps getting yanked back to the bottom, uncontrollably.
- **/laneconductor plan doesn't reliably populate test.md** (Track 1095): Fixes the gap where test.md is created/left as a generic stub instead of being populated with test cases during the plan or implement phase.
- **Choose/change a worker's CLI + model from the UI** (Track 1096): No UI exists to choose a worker's CLI/model when starting one, or to change an existing worker's model assignment afterward — today it's CLI-only, via .laneconductor.json's primary/secondary config…
- **Build Artifact System & AI Release Notes Synthesizer** (Track 1097): Build artifact storage, API endpoint, CLI command (`lc build`), and AI synthesis engine to generate categorized release notes from completed tracks.
- **Targeted Build Deployment UI & Release Notes Preview** (Track 1098): Deploy Modal UI update to support selecting specific Build Artifacts, rendering AI release notes, and dispatching build-tagged deployment workers.
- **Production Sync Test** (Track 9999): Test track to verify worker syncs to production
- **Concurrency A 1776105185643** (Track 10000): Test description
- **Brainstorm B 1776105185643** (Track 10001): Test description
- **E2E Test 1776105188197** (Track 10002): Automated Playwright e2e — verifies new track flows to worker and back

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- **Track 1030 Setup Scaffold Fix** (Track 1030): Resolved redundant questions and missing configuration gaps in CLI. Fixed quality gate timeout by optimizing implementation.
- **Bug-to-Test Flow** (Track 1045): The "Open Bug" action is split across two frontend fetch calls with no test.md update. We need a single atomic backend endpoint that handles all side-effects.
- **Fix bidirectional sync - newer wins strategy** (Track 1066): Currently sync only reads filesystem → DB. No mechanism exists to detect when DB has newer data or to compare versions.
- **Fix `lc worker restart` missing canonical sync-script fallback** (Track 1074): Fixed — extracted a shared `resolveSyncScript()` helper used by both `start` and `restart`; `restart` now resolves the script before touching the running worker, so a resolution failure no longer…
- **Fix `/track` POST timeouts + unverified "processed" marking in file_sync_queue** (Track 1076): Fixed both bugs. Root cause of the timeout: chokidar's `ignoreInitial: false` fires an 'add' event per existing file on worker start — ~400 near-simultaneous syncTrack() calls for this project's…
- **Bug — `**Summary**` marker gets silently overwritten with wrong content** (Track 1081): `index.md`'s `**Summary**` marker gets clobbered with wrong/generic content by at least two distinct mechanisms — one traced to an exact line of code, one only reproduced live and not yet…
- **Sync Worker Metadata Corruption — Bug Sprint** (Track 1088): Fixed four sync-worker bugs corrupting Progress/Phase/Summary; found and resolved a fifth, separate structural issue (duplicate track-number folders) with an auto-remediating fix.
- **Sync Worker Bug Sprint — Track 180 Investigation** (Track 1093): Two independent sync bugs found investigating one live report ("track 180 not syncing") — a DB→FS timestamp bug and an FS→DB conversation.md parser bug, both permanent-silent-failure patterns, not…
